about: I work across moving images, photography and visual design — with a focus on atmosphere, visual storytelling and independent creative expression.
about_bio:
I'm a filmmaker, director and photographer based in Germany, with a particular focus on directing and visual storytelling.

My work ranges from independent short films to feature-length productions, music videos and photography. I enjoy developing ideas from the first concept to the finished film, experimenting with different visual styles and finding ways to tell stories through images.

Alongside my own projects, I've gained experience working on film and television sets in different roles, both behind the camera and as part of the production team. These experiences have given me a broader understanding of filmmaking and the people and processes involved.

While directing remains my main focus, photography, editing and other creative disciplines continue to influence the way I approach my work.
